name: Evidian
abstract: Evidian Web Access Manager, part of Evidian's Web Access Management and Identity Governance suite from France (Eviden/Atos Group), includes an OAuth 2.0 Authorization Server and can act as both an OpenID Connect and SAML 2.0 Identity Provider for web application SSO, identity federation, and API access control.
